title: Ugly, over-priced, heavy Bowls
text:
Ugly, over-priced, heavy Bowls. Very OVERPRICED for clumsy, heavy bowl.
Too easy to drop & break. Underwhelming with lousy multi-coloured "striping" job that doesn't even match up.

product_metadata.title: DOWAN 5.8" Deep Soup Bowls & Cereal Bowls - 30 Ounces Large Bowls Set of 4 for Kitchen - Ceramic Bowls for Cereal, Soup, Oatmeal, Salad, Ramen, Noodle, Rice - Dishwasher & Oven Safe (Black)
features: Unexpectedly Deep Bowls: 3.5 Inches height is deeper than most bowls, you can put a full portion of food in them and have plenty of room left, don't have to be worried of spilling hot soup. They are like the perfect general use bowl that can meet daily needs like oatmeal, cereal, gumbo, soup, ramen, salad, chili, pasta, frozen dinner, quick box meals. Never be tired of bowls too shallow.

Elegant Bow Design: Allowing your hands to hold the bowl more comfortably, while bringing more practical capacity without having to go back and increase food multiple times. They are the goldie locks weight - not light not heavy, just right. And with the tall sides it really gives them a sturdy base on the table.
Remarkable Stackability: Sturdy and thick wall that can stand firmly in the cabinet, special outer line design with slight radian makes them easy to stack.

Safe and Durable Top Grade Porcelain: No harmful plastics, cadmium or Lead. Microwave, oven, refrigerator and dishwasher safe. The long-lasting material blocks moisture absorption and prevents cracking.
Well Packaged For Perfect Condition: Our packaging is used with the best EPE foams to ensure the safety in transit, these bowls will arrive at your hand safely.
